1	"""The one client for every generative model call: OpenRouter's chat completions API.
     2	
     3	No module calls a model provider directly. Each module receives a `ChatClient` (or a fake
     4	with the same `complete` method) as its client argument. Every call goes through
     5	`monitoring.cached_call`, so it is cached on disk and its tokens and latency are recorded.
     6	
     7	Reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL from the environment or .env; the key
     8	is never printed or logged. Jev is not served by OpenRouter and keeps its own client
     9	(typesafe_sdk, TYPESAFE_API_KEY).
    10	"""
    11	
    12	import json
    13	import os
    14	from typing import Any, Protocol
    15	
    16	import httpx
    17	from dotenv import load_dotenv
    18	from pydantic import BaseModel
    19	
    20	from triage_app import thresholds
    21	from triage_app.cache import DiskCache
    22	from triage_app.config import ROOT
    23	from triage_app.monitoring import Recorder, cached_call
    24	
    25	DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
    26	
    27	
    28	class Message(BaseModel):
    29	    role: str  # "system" | "user" | "assistant"
    30	    content: str
    31	
    32	
    33	class Completion(BaseModel):
    34	    text: str
    35	    model: str
    36	    input_tokens: int | None = None
    37	    output_tokens: int | None = None
    38	
    39	
    40	class ChatClient(Protocol):
    41	    def complete(self, *, model: str, messages: list[Message], max_tokens: int = thresholds.LLM_MAX_TOKENS,
    42	                 temperature: float = thresholds.LLM_TEMPERATURE, response_format: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    43	                 namespace: str = "chat", criteria_version: str = "") -> Completion: ...
    44	
    45	
    46	class OpenRouterClient:
    47	    """Chat completions over OpenRouter, cached and monitored."""
    48	
    49	    def __init__(self, *, api_key: str | None = None, base_url: str | None = None,
    50	                 cache: DiskCache | None = None, use_cache: bool = True,
    51	                 recorder: Recorder | None = None, timeout: float = thresholds.LLM_TIMEOUT_S) -> None:
    52	        load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
    53	        self._api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY", "")
    54	        self.base_url = (base_url or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_BASE_URL") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL).rstrip("/")
    55	        self.cache = (cache or DiskCache()) if use_cache else None
    56	        self.recorder = recorder
    57	        self.timeout = timeout
    58	
    59	    def _post(self, body: dict[str, Any]) -> Completion:
    60	        if not self._api_key:
    61	            raise RuntimeError("OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not set")
    62	        resp = httpx.post(
    63	            f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions",
    64	            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    65	            json=body, timeout=self.timeout,
    66	        )
    67	        if resp.status_code >= 400:
    68	            raise RuntimeError(f"OpenRouter {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:500]}")
    69	        data = resp.json()
    70	        usage = data.get("usage") or {}
    71	        return Completion(
    72	            text=data["choices"][0]["message"].get("content") or "",
    73	            model=data.get("model", body["model"]),
    74	            input_tokens=usage.get("prompt_tokens"),
    75	            output_tokens=usage.get("completion_tokens"),
    76	        )
    77	
    78	    def complete(self, *, model: str, messages: list[Message], max_tokens: int = thresholds.LLM_MAX_TOKENS,
    79	                 temperature: float = thresholds.LLM_TEMPERATURE, response_format: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    80	                 namespace: str = "chat", criteria_version: str = "") -> Completion:
    81	        body: dict[str, Any] = {
    82	            "model": model,
    83	            "messages": [m.model_dump() for m in messages],
    84	            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
    85	            "temperature": temperature,
    86	            "usage": {"include": True},
    87	        }
    88	        if response_format is not None:
    89	            body["response_format"] = response_format
    90	        return cached_call(
    91	            namespace=namespace, model=model, payload=body,
    92	            call=lambda: self._post(body),
    93	            dump=lambda c: c.model_dump(), load=Completion.model_validate,
    94	            usage=lambda c: (c.input_tokens, c.output_tokens),
    95	            input_text=json.dumps(body["messages"]), criteria_version=criteria_version,
    96	            cache=self.cache, recorder=self.recorder,
    97	        )

    57	SAFETY_QUESTIONS = ("possible_mnpi", "instructs_ai")
    58	
    59	CRITERIA_FILES = (
    60	    "thesis_relevant", "monitor", "redundant", "low_value", "irrelevant",
    61	    "human_attention", "macro", "sector", "government", "other", "affected_tickers",
    62	)
    63	
    64	# ---- Models ----
    65	# Every model ID comes from .env (or the environment); none is defined here. Each name
    66	# below is read when first used, so modules and tests that need no model never require it.
    67	#   JEV_MODEL         TypeSafe model for stage 3, e.g. a pinned jev-<version>
    68	#   ANALYSIS_MODEL    OpenRouter slug: extraction, analysis agent, verify agent, generation prompts
    69	#   NOTES_MODEL       OpenRouter slug: attention notes
    70	#   EMBEDDING_MODEL   local fastembed model: redundancy check, duplicate checks, filing search
    71	
    72	MODEL_ENV_VARS = ("JEV_MODEL", "ANALYSIS_MODEL", "NOTES_MODEL", "EMBEDDING_MODEL")
    73	
    74	load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
    75	
    76	
    77	class MissingModelError(RuntimeError):
    78	    pass
    79	
    80	
    81	def model_id(name: str) -> str:
    82	    """The model ID set in .env for `name`; raises when it is unset."""
    83	    if name not in MODEL_ENV_VARS:
    84	        raise KeyError(name)
    85	    value = os.environ.get(name, "").strip()
    86	    if not value:
    87	        raise MissingModelError(f"{name} is not set; add it to .env (see .env.example)")
    88	    return value

     1	"""On-disk cache for model calls and embeddings, committed under data/cache/.
     2	
     3	Keys hash the program version, the criteria version and the input, so a rerun on the
     4	same inputs costs nothing and the demo is deterministic.
     5	"""
     6	
     7	import hashlib
     8	import json
     9	from pathlib import Path
    10	from typing import Any
    11	
    12	from triage_app.config import CACHE_DIR
    13	
    14	PROGRAM_VERSION = "0.1.0"
    15	
    16	
    17	def cache_key(namespace: str, payload: Any, criteria_version: str = "") -> str:
    18	    blob = json.dumps(
    19	        {"program": PROGRAM_VERSION, "criteria": criteria_version, "ns": namespace, "in": payload},
    20	        sort_keys=True, default=str, ensure_ascii=False,
    21	    )
    22	    return hashlib.sha256(blob.encode()).hexdigest()
    23	
    24	
    25	class DiskCache:
    26	    """One JSON file per entry: {"value": ..., "input_tokens": n, "output_tokens": n, "estimated": b}."""
    27	
    28	    def __init__(self, root: Path = CACHE_DIR) -> None:
    29	        self.root = root
    30	
    31	    def _path(self, namespace: str, key: str) -> Path:
    32	        return self.root / namespace / key[:2] / f"{key}.json"
    33	
    34	    def get(self, namespace: str, key: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    35	        path = self._path(namespace, key)
    36	        if not path.exists():
    37	            return None
    38	        entry: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text())
    39	        return entry
    40	
    41	    def put(self, namespace: str, key: str, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    42	        path = self._path(namespace, key)
    43	        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    44	        path.write_text(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
     1	"""The one embedder: a Hugging Face model, pulled from the Hub and run locally.
     2	
     3	The model is the repo ID in .env as EMBEDDING_MODEL (sentence-transformers). Used by the
     4	redundancy check (stage 2), the duplicate and merge checks for new theses (stages 7 and 8)
     5	and the verify agent's filing search. Each text's vector is cached on disk and every batch
     6	is recorded by monitoring. Vectors are L2-normalized, so a dot product is cosine similarity.
     7	
     8	Tests pass a fake with the same `embed` / `count_tokens` / `max_tokens` surface.
     9	"""
    10	
    11	from typing import Protocol
    12	
    13	import numpy as np
    14	from numpy.typing import NDArray
    15	
    16	from triage_app import thresholds
    17	from triage_app import config
    18	from triage_app.cache import DiskCache
    19	from triage_app.monitoring import Recorder, cached_call
    20	
    21	Vector = NDArray[np.float32]
    22	
    23	
    24	class Embedder(Protocol):
    25	    model: str
    26	    max_tokens: int
    27	
    28	    def count_tokens(self, text: str) -> int: ...
    29	
    30	    def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> Vector: ...  # shape (len(texts), dim), normalized
    31	
    32	
    33	class HFEmbedder:
    34	    def __init__(self, model: str | None = None, *, cache: DiskCache | None = None,
    35	                 use_cache: bool = True, recorder: Recorder | None = None) -> None:
    36	        from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
    37	
    38	        self.model = model or config.EMBEDDING_MODEL
    39	        self._st = SentenceTransformer(self.model)
    40	        self.max_tokens = int(self._st.max_seq_length or thresholds.EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS)
    41	        self.cache = (cache or DiskCache()) if use_cache else None
    42	        self.recorder = recorder
    43	
    44	    def count_tokens(self, text: str) -> int:
    45	        return len(self._st.tokenizer(text, add_special_tokens=True)["input_ids"])
    46	
    47	    def _encode(self, text: str) -> list[float]:
    48	        vec = self._st.encode([text], normalize_embeddings=True, convert_to_numpy=True)[0]
    49	        return [float(x) for x in vec]
    50	
    51	    def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> Vector:
    52	        rows = []
    53	        for text in texts:
    54	            rows.append(cached_call(
    55	                namespace="embed", model=self.model, payload={"model": self.model, "text": text},
    56	                call=lambda t=text: self._encode(t),  # type: ignore[misc]
    57	                dump=lambda v: v, load=lambda v: list(v),
    58	                usage=lambda _v, t=text: (self.count_tokens(t), 0),  # type: ignore[misc]
    59	                input_text=text, cache=self.cache, recorder=self.recorder,
    60	            ))
    61	        return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)

1	"""What every stage's `run` receives besides its directories: clients, settings, monitoring.
     2	
     3	Clients are built lazily on first use, so a stage that needs no model never loads one,
     4	and tests pass fakes in their place:
     5	
     6	    ctx = RunContext(corpus_set="day_1", chat=FakeChat(...), embedder=FakeEmbedder(), jev=FakeJev(...))
     7	"""
     8	
     9	from typing import Any
    10	
    11	from triage_app import thresholds
    12	from triage_app import config
    13	from triage_app.cache import DiskCache
    14	from triage_app.config import CorpusSet
    15	from triage_app.embed import Embedder
    16	from triage_app.llm import ChatClient
    17	from triage_app.monitoring import Recorder
    18	from triage_app.schema import CriteriaSet, Thresholds
    19	
    20	
    21	class RunContext:
    22	    def __init__(self, corpus_set: CorpusSet | None = None, *, recorder: Recorder | None = None,
    23	                 cache: DiskCache | None = None, use_cache: bool = True, chat: ChatClient | None = None,
    24	                 embedder: Embedder | None = None, jev: Any | None = None,
    25	                 criteria: CriteriaSet | None = None, thresholds: Thresholds | None = None) -> None:
    26	        self.corpus_set = corpus_set
    27	        self.recorder = recorder or Recorder()
    28	        self.cache = (cache or DiskCache()) if use_cache else None
    29	        self._chat, self._embedder, self._jev = chat, embedder, jev
    30	        self._criteria, self._thresholds = criteria, thresholds
    31	
    32	    @property
    33	    def chat(self) -> ChatClient:
    34	        """OpenRouter chat client for every generative call."""
    35	        if self._chat is None:
    36	            from triage_app.llm import OpenRouterClient
    37	            self._chat = OpenRouterClient(cache=self.cache, use_cache=self.cache is not None,
    38	                                          recorder=self.recorder)
    39	        return self._chat
    40	
    41	    @property
    42	    def embedder(self) -> Embedder:
    43	        if self._embedder is None:
    44	            from triage_app.embed import HFEmbedder
    45	            self._embedder = HFEmbedder(cache=self.cache, use_cache=self.cache is not None,
    46	                                        recorder=self.recorder)
    47	        return self._embedder
    48	
    49	    @property
    50	    def jev(self) -> Any:
    51	        """TypeSafe client for stage 3 (Jev). The classify module wraps calls in cached_call."""
    52	        if self._jev is None:
    53	            from dotenv import load_dotenv
    54	            from typesafe_sdk import TypeSafeClient
    55	            load_dotenv(config.ROOT / ".env")
    56	            self._jev = TypeSafeClient(model=config.JEV_MODEL, timeout=thresholds.JEV_TIMEOUT_S)
    57	        return self._jev
    58	
    59	    @property
    60	    def criteria(self) -> CriteriaSet:
    61	        if self._criteria is None:
    62	            from triage_app.criteria import load
    63	            self._criteria = load()
    64	        return self._criteria
    65	
    66	    @property
    67	    def thresholds(self) -> Thresholds:
    68	        if self._thresholds is None:
    69	            self._thresholds = thresholds.load_thresholds()
    70	        return self._thresholds
     1	"""Run the pipeline over one corpus set, writing every stage file to data/out/<set>/.
     2	
     3	    uv run python -m triage_app.pipeline.run --set day_1
     4	    uv run python -m triage_app.pipeline.run --set day_1 --stage classify   # one stage
     5	    uv run python -m triage_app.pipeline.run --set day_1 --from extract     # a stage onward
     6	
     7	Stages run in order. Stage A (attention) runs after the gate, beside 5 to 8. Each stage
     8	is timed for the set, stages time each email themselves through the recorder, and the
     9	run ends by writing usage.json and metrics.json and printing the monitoring summary.
    10	"""
    11	
    12	import argparse
    13	import importlib
    14	import json
    15	from pathlib import Path
    16	from types import ModuleType
    17	
    18	from triage_app import config
    19	from triage_app.config import CorpusSet
    20	from triage_app.monitoring import format_summary, recording
    21	from triage_app.pipeline.context import RunContext
    22	
    23	STAGES = ("parse", "redundancy", "classify", "gate", "attention",
    24	          "extract", "analyze", "validate", "merge", "deliver")
    25	
    26	
    27	def stage_module(name: str) -> ModuleType:
    28	    return importlib.import_module(f"triage_app.pipeline.{name}")
    29	
    30	
    31	def select(stage: str | None, start: str | None) -> list[str]:
    32	    if stage and start:
    33	        raise SystemExit("use --stage or --from, not both")
    34	    if stage:
    35	        return [stage]
    36	    if start:
    37	        return list(STAGES[STAGES.index(start):])
    38	    return list(STAGES)
    39	
    40	
    41	def run_set(corpus_set: CorpusSet, stages: list[str], ctx: RunContext | None = None,
    42	            corpus_dir: Path | None = None, out: Path | None = None) -> None:
    43	    ctx = ctx or RunContext(corpus_set)
    44	    corpus_dir = corpus_dir or config.CORPUS_DIR / corpus_set
    45	    out = out or config.out_dir(corpus_set)
    46	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    47	    with recording(ctx.recorder):
    48	        for name in stages:
    49	            in_dir = corpus_dir if name == "parse" else out
    50	            print(f"[{corpus_set}] {name} ...", flush=True)
    51	            with ctx.recorder.stage(name):
    52	                stage_module(name).run(in_dir, out, ctx)
    53	    parsed = out / "parsed.json"
    54	    emails = len(json.loads(parsed.read_text())) if parsed.exists() else 0
    55	    report = ctx.recorder.write(out, corpus_set, emails)
    56	    print(format_summary(report))
    57	
    58	
    59	def main() -> None:
    60	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    61	    parser.add_argument("--set", dest="corpus_set", required=True, choices=config.CORPUS_SETS)
    62	    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES)
    63	    parser.add_argument("--from", dest="start", choices=STAGES)
    64	    args = parser.parse_args()
    65	    run_set(args.corpus_set, select(args.stage, args.start))
    66	
    67	
    68	if __name__ == "__main__":
    69	    main()
     1	"""Every threshold, limit and tunable number in the pipeline, in one place.
     2	
     3	This is the only module that defines them. Code everywhere reads `thresholds.NAME`; no
     4	other module writes one of these numbers. To audit or change a value, change it here.
     5	
     6	"Set by" says how each value is chosen (SPEC.md, "Starting values" and "Tuning"):
     7	  fixed     chosen by hand, never tuned
     8	  sweep     a starting value; `evals/tune.py` fits it on the tuning set's fit split and
     9	            writes tuned/thresholds.json, which overrides it at run time (`load_thresholds`)
    10	
    11	Model IDs are not numbers and live only in .env (see config.py).
    12	"""
    13	
    14	from pathlib import Path
    15	
    16	from triage_app.schema import Thresholds, Ticker, Topic
    17	
    18	# ---- Stage 4: label and gate ----------------------------------------------------------
    19	
    20	PASS_SIGNAL = 0.6            # sweep  signal score P(thesis_relevant)+P(monitor) that passes the gate
    21	ATTENTION = 0.6              # sweep  attention probability that flags human attention
    22	TICKER_THRESHOLD = 0.5       # sweep  per-ticker probability that lists a company (each ticker tuned)
    23	TOPIC_THRESHOLD = 0.5        # sweep  per-topic probability that lists a topic (each topic tuned)
    24	QUARANTINE = 0.65            # fixed  either safety probability (possible_mnpi, instructs_ai) that quarantines
    25	SIGNAL_SCORE_DECIMALS = 6    # fixed  signal score is rounded before comparing, so 0.3 + 0.3 counts as 0.60
    26	
    27	# ---- Stage 2: redundancy check (fixed: the corpus has no redundant_of labels) ---------
    28	
    29	CONTENT_SIMILARITY = 0.85                # fixed  cosine that flags a repeat on content alone
    30	CONTENT_SIMILARITY_WITH_SUBJECT = 0.75   # fixed  cosine that flags a repeat when subjects match
    31	SUBJECT_MATCH = 0.6                      # fixed  token-set subject similarity that counts as a match
    32	EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS = 512               # fixed  fallback input limit if the embedder reports none
    33	SPECIAL_TOKEN_HEADROOM = 8               # fixed  tokens kept free under that limit when chunking
    34	
    35	# ---- Stage 3: Jev -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    36	
    37	JEV_INPUT_LIMIT_TOKENS = 32_000   # fixed  email plus the longest question; beyond it the body is trimmed
    38	CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4               # fixed  token estimate where a provider reports none
    39	
    40	# ---- Stages 6 to 8: analysis, validation, merging ----------------------------------------
    41	
    42	SKILL_CALLS_PER_EMAIL = 3         # fixed  analysis-agent skill calls per email
    43	NEW_THESIS_DUPLICATE = 0.8        # fixed  cosine at which a new thesis duplicates an existing pillar (rejected)
    44	NEW_THESIS_MERGE = 0.8            # fixed  cosine at which two new-thesis candidates merge
    45	
    46	# ---- Delivery, alerts and the book --------------------------------------------------------
    47	
    48	ALERTS_PER_DAY = 3                # fixed  alert budget; overflow stays in the brief
    49	ALERT_ATTENTION = 0.8             # fixed  attention probability that raises an alert
    50	ALERT_WRONG_IF_MIN_BPS = 150      # fixed  position size at which a met "wrong if" test raises an alert
    51	CONVICTION_REVIEW_STRENGTH = 4    # fixed  net contradicting strength on a pillar that raises a conviction review
    52	
    53	# ---- Verify agent -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    54	
    55	VERIFY_TOOL_CALLS = 4             # fixed  tool calls per verify request
    56	PASSAGE_CHARS = 1200              # fixed  filing passages are cut at this length (inside the embedder's limit)
    57	MIN_PASSAGE_CHARS = 80            # fixed  shorter paragraphs join the next one
    58	
    59	# ---- Live route ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    60	
    61	LIVE_INPUT_CAP_CHARS = 10_000     # fixed  longest pasted email accepted
    62	LIVE_RUNS_PER_HOUR = 5            # fixed  live runs (and "this mattered") per visitor session
    63	LIVE_RATE_WINDOW_S = 3600.0       # fixed  window for that limit, in seconds
    64	
    65	# ---- Model calls --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    66	
    67	LLM_TEMPERATURE = 0.0             # fixed  every generative call
    68	LLM_MAX_TOKENS = 4096             # fixed  default output cap for a chat call
    69	DSPY_MAX_TOKENS = 8000            # fixed  output cap for DSPy modules (notes, extraction, skills, agents)
    70	LLM_TIMEOUT_S = 300.0             # fixed  OpenRouter request timeout
    71	JEV_TIMEOUT_S = 60.0              # fixed  TypeSafe request timeout
    72	
    73	# ---- Criteria files -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    74	
    75	RULES_PER_CRITERIA_FILE = 12      # fixed  most rules a criteria file may hold
    76	
    77	# ---- Tuning (evals/tune.py) ---------------------------------------------------------------
    78	
    79	MONITOR_PASS_SHARE = 0.95         # fixed  share of monitor emails the tuned pass threshold must still pass
    80	PASS_THRESHOLD_DECIMALS = 4       # fixed  the tuned pass threshold is floored to this many decimals
    81	SPLIT_SEED = 13                   # fixed  seed of the tuning set's fit/validation split
    82	FIT_SHARE = 2 / 3                 # fixed  share of each label that goes to the fit split
    83	
    84	# ---- Corpus report targets (from the corpus prompt, per 300 emails; scaled by set size) --
    85	
    86	TARGET_BASE = 300
    87	HUMAN_ATTENTION_RANGE = (15, 25)
    88	MACRO_SECTOR_GOVERNMENT_RANGE = (25, 35)
    89	
    90	
    91	# ---- Thresholds the gate reads: starting values, overridden by tuned/thresholds.json ----
    92	
    93	def starting_thresholds() -> Thresholds:
    94	    from triage_app.config import TICKERS, TOPICS
    95	
    96	    tickers: tuple[Ticker, ...] = TICKERS
    97	    topics: tuple[Topic, ...] = TOPICS
    98	    return Thresholds(
    99	        pass_signal=PASS_SIGNAL,
   100	        attention=ATTENTION,
   101	        ticker={t: TICKER_THRESHOLD for t in tickers},
   102	        topic={t: TOPIC_THRESHOLD for t in topics},
   103	        content_similarity=CONTENT_SIMILARITY,
   104	        content_similarity_with_subject=CONTENT_SIMILARITY_WITH_SUBJECT,
   105	        subject_match=SUBJECT_MATCH,
   106	    )
   107	
   108	
   109	def load_thresholds(path: Path | None = None) -> Thresholds:
   110	    """Tuned values from tuned/thresholds.json when it exists, starting values otherwise.
   111	
   112	    The redundancy thresholds are fixed, so they always come from this module.
   113	    """
   114	    from triage_app.config import TUNED_THRESHOLDS
   115	
   116	    path = path or TUNED_THRESHOLDS
   117	    if not path.exists():
   118	        return starting_thresholds()
   119	    tuned = Thresholds.model_validate_json(path.read_text())
   120	    return tuned.model_copy(update={
   121	        "content_similarity": CONTENT_SIMILARITY,
   122	        "content_similarity_with_subject": CONTENT_SIMILARITY_WITH_SUBJECT,
   123	        "subject_match": SUBJECT_MATCH,
   124	    })

     1	"""Stage 4 Label and gate: triage.json, redundancy.json -> results.json.
     2	
     3	Owned by work package 4 (Classify and gate). See SPEC.md: Classification with Jev.
     4	
     5	Pure code, in this order: quarantine, label, tickers and topics, attention, gate on the
     6	signal score. The one-line reason is composed here from probabilities and thresholds
     7	(wording in DECISIONS.md #21); no model writes it.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	from pathlib import Path
    11	
    12	from triage_app import thresholds as limits  # the module; `thresholds` here is a Thresholds value
    13	from triage_app import config
    14	from triage_app.pipeline.context import RunContext
    15	from triage_app.pipeline.io import read_list, write_list
    16	from triage_app.schema import EmailResult, RedundancyRecord, Thresholds, TriageRecord
    17	
    18	STAGE = "gate"
    19	
    20	
    21	def run(in_dir: Path, out_dir: Path, ctx: RunContext) -> None:
    22	    triage = read_list(in_dir / "triage.json", TriageRecord)
    23	    redundancy = {r.email_id: r for r in read_list(in_dir / "redundancy.json", RedundancyRecord)}
    24	    thresholds = ctx.thresholds
    25	    results: list[EmailResult] = []
    26	    for record in triage:
    27	        with ctx.recorder.stage(STAGE, record.email_id):
    28	            results.append(process(record, redundancy[record.email_id], thresholds))
    29	    write_list(out_dir / "results.json", results)
    30	
    31	
    32	def signal_score(triage: TriageRecord) -> float:
    33	    """P(thesis_relevant) + P(monitor), rounded so float noise never moves the gate."""
    34	    return round(triage.triage_probs.get("thesis_relevant", 0.0) + triage.triage_probs.get("monitor", 0.0), limits.SIGNAL_SCORE_DECIMALS)
    35	
    36	
    37	def process(triage: TriageRecord, redundancy: RedundancyRecord, thresholds: Thresholds) -> EmailResult:
    38	    """Quarantine, label, tickers and topics, attention, gate; reason composed by code."""
    39	    signal = signal_score(triage)
    40	
    41	    # 1. Quarantine on either safety question; nothing further runs.
    42	    tripped = {q: p for q, p in triage.safety.items() if p >= limits.QUARANTINE}
    43	    if tripped:
    44	        question = max(tripped, key=lambda q: tripped[q])
    45	        return EmailResult(
    46	            email_id=triage.email_id, triage=None, decided_by="quarantine", redundant_of=None,
    47	            affected_tickers=[], additional_labels=[], human_attention=False,
    48	            signal_score=signal, gate="quarantine",
    49	            reason=f"quarantined: {question} {tripped[question]:.2f} reaches {limits.QUARANTINE:.2f}",
    50	        )
    51	
    52	    # 2. Label: Jev's most probable label, unless the check flags a repeat below the gate.
    53	    jev_label = max(config.TRIAGE_LABELS, key=lambda label: triage.triage_probs.get(label, 0.0))
    54	    jev_part = f"{jev_label} {triage.triage_probs.get(jev_label, 0.0):.2f}"
    55	    label, decided_by, redundant_of, label_part = jev_label, "jev", None, jev_part
    56	    if (redundancy.flagged and signal < thresholds.pass_signal
    57	            and jev_label != "redundant" and redundancy.nearest is not None):
    58	        label, decided_by, redundant_of = "redundant", "redundancy_check", redundancy.nearest
    59	        label_part = (f"redundant: repeat of {redundancy.nearest} "
    60	                      f"(content {redundancy.content_similarity or 0.0:.2f}, "
    61	                      f"subject {redundancy.subject_score or 0.0:.2f}); jev {jev_part}")
    62	
    63	    # 3. Tickers and topics at their thresholds.
    64	    tickers = [t for t in config.TICKERS
    65	               if triage.ticker_probs.get(t, 0.0) >= thresholds.ticker.get(t, limits.TICKER_THRESHOLD)]
    66	    topics = [t for t in config.TOPICS
    67	              if triage.topic_probs.get(t, 0.0) >= thresholds.topic.get(t, limits.TOPIC_THRESHOLD)]
    68	
    69	    # 4. Human attention.
    70	    attention = triage.attention >= thresholds.attention
    71	
    72	    # 5. Gate on the signal score, or pass a truncated email on its first chunk.
    73	    if signal >= thresholds.pass_signal:
    74	        gate, gate_part = "pass", f"signal score {signal:.2f} clears {thresholds.pass_signal:.2f}"
    75	    elif triage.truncated:
    76	        gate, gate_part = "pass", (f"signal score {signal:.2f} is below {thresholds.pass_signal:.2f}; "
    77	                                   "truncated, passed on the first chunk")
    78	    else:
    79	        gate, gate_part = "stop", f"signal score {signal:.2f} is below {thresholds.pass_signal:.2f}"
    80	
    81	    return EmailResult(
    82	        email_id=triage.email_id, triage=label, decided_by=decided_by, redundant_of=redundant_of,
    83	        affected_tickers=tickers, additional_labels=topics, human_attention=attention,
    84	        signal_score=signal, gate=gate, reason=f"{label_part}; {gate_part}",
    85	    )

1	"""Stage 2 Check for repeats: parsed.json -> redundancy.json, vectors.npy.
     2	
     3	Owned by work package 3 (Redundancy). See SPEC.md: Redundancy check; Starting values.
     4	
     5	For each email, in arrival order: embed the cleaned body (chunked mean, L2-normalized),
     6	find the most similar earlier email of the same day by cosine, score the two subjects by
     7	token-set similarity, flag a potential repeat, and add the email to the day cache. The flag
     8	is a hint only; stage 4 decides the label. No generative model is called here.
     9	"""
    10	
    11	import re
    12	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    13	from pathlib import Path
    14	
    15	import numpy as np
    16	from rapidfuzz import fuzz
    17	
    18	from triage_app import thresholds
    19	from triage_app.embed import Embedder, Vector
    20	from triage_app.pipeline.context import RunContext
    21	from triage_app.pipeline.io import read_list, write_list
    22	from triage_app.schema import Email, RedundancyRecord
    23	
    24	STAGE = "redundancy"
    25	
    26	
    27	_PREFIX = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:re|fwd|fw)\s*:\s*")
    28	_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^\w\s]")
    29	_PARAGRAPH = re.compile(r"\n\s*\n")
    30	_SENTENCE = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+")
    31	
    32	
    33	@dataclass
    34	class DayCache:
    35	    """Earlier emails of the same day: IDs, normalized subjects and vectors, in arrival order."""
    36	
    37	    ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    38	    subjects: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    39	    vectors: list[Vector] = field(default_factory=list)
    40	
    41	    def add(self, email_id: str, subject: str, vector: Vector) -> None:
    42	        self.ids.append(email_id)
    43	        self.subjects.append(subject)
    44	        self.vectors.append(vector)
    45	
    46	    def nearest(self, vector: Vector) -> tuple[str, float, str] | None:
    47	        """(email_id, cosine, normalized subject) of the most similar earlier email, if any."""
    48	        if not self.ids:
    49	            return None
    50	        sims = np.vstack(self.vectors) @ vector
    51	        i = int(np.argmax(sims))
    52	        return self.ids[i], float(sims[i]), self.subjects[i]
    53	
    54	
    55	def normalize_subject(subject: str) -> str:
    56	    """Lower-case, strip leading re:/fw:/fwd: prefixes repeatedly, strip punctuation."""
    57	    s = subject.lower()

    68	def _pack(pieces: list[str], sep: str, budget: int, embedder: Embedder) -> list[str]:
    69	    """Greedily join consecutive pieces while the joined text stays within `budget` tokens."""
    70	    chunks: list[str] = []
    71	    current = ""
    72	    for piece in pieces:
    73	        candidate = f"{current}{sep}{piece}" if current else piece
    74	        if current and embedder.count_tokens(candidate) > budget:
    75	            chunks.append(current)
    76	            current = piece
    77	        else:
    78	            current = candidate
    79	    if current:
    80	        chunks.append(current)

    84	def chunk_text(text: str, embedder: Embedder) -> list[str]:
    85	    """Split text into chunks that fit the embedder's input limit.
    86	
    87	    Paragraphs first, then sentences within an oversized paragraph, then words within an
    88	    oversized sentence (a last resort so no chunk is ever truncated by the model).
    89	    """
    90	    budget = max(1, embedder.max_tokens - thresholds.SPECIAL_TOKEN_HEADROOM)
    91	    pieces: list[str] = []

    93	        if not para:
    94	            continue
    95	        if embedder.count_tokens(para) <= budget:
    96	            pieces.append(para)
    97	            continue
    98	        for sentence in (s.strip() for s in _SENTENCE.split(para)):
    99	            if not sentence:
   100	                continue
   101	            if embedder.count_tokens(sentence) <= budget:
   102	                pieces.append(sentence)
   103	            else:
   104	                pieces.extend(_pack(sentence.split(), " ", budget, embedder))

   109	def email_vector(text: str, embedder: Embedder) -> Vector:
   110	    """Mean of the chunk vectors, L2-normalized, as float32. One embed call for all chunks."""
   111	    rows = embedder.embed(chunk_text(text, embedder))

   113	    norm = float(np.linalg.norm(mean))
   114	    return (mean / norm if norm else mean).astype(np.float32)

   117	def process(email: Email, day: DayCache, ctx: RunContext) -> RedundancyRecord:
   118	    """Compare one email with the earlier emails in `day` (the day cache), then add it to the cache."""

   121	    found = day.nearest(vector)

   123	    if found is None:

   125	                                subject_score=None, flagged=False)

     2	
     3	Pure code. See SPEC.md: Merging in stage 8; Order and alerts (ordering only; alerts are
     4	stage 9's). Only open suggestions are kept; rejected ones stay in suggestions_checked.json.
     5	
     6	- Existing-thesis suggestions on the same pillar and stance merge into one, with ID
     7	  `<pillar_id>.<stance>`: the highest strength (ties go to the email with the higher
     8	  signal score, then the earlier suggestion), its rationale, `wrong_if_met` if any had it,
     9	  assumptions pooled one per driver and stated value, and every claim and section kept.
    10	  Opposite stances on one pillar stay two suggestions.
    11	- New-thesis candidates for one company merge when a statement's cosine with a group's
    12	  first statement reaches `thresholds.NEW_THESIS_MERGE`. The first candidate's statement,
    13	  "wrong if" test and rationale are kept; drivers, claims and sections are pooled. IDs
    14	  are `<ticker>.new<n>`, numbered per company in arrival order.
    15	- Second look is recomputed from the merged emails.
    16	- Order: existing pillars by position size, then strength, then the highest signal score
    17	  among the linked emails; then new-thesis candidates by position size, then signal score.
    18	"""
    19	
    20	from collections import defaultdict
    21	from pathlib import Path
    22	from typing import Any
    23	
    24	from triage_app import thresholds
    25	from triage_app import config
    26	from triage_app.pipeline.context import RunContext
    27	from triage_app.pipeline.io import read_list, write_list
    28	from triage_app.pipeline.validate import linked_emails, needs_second_look
    29	from triage_app.schema import EmailResult, ExistingThesis, LinkedAssumption, LinkedSection, NewThesis, Suggestion
    30	from triage_app.state.fold import Seed, load_seed
    31	
    32	STAGE = "merge"
    33	
    34	
    35	def _signal(s: Suggestion, results: dict[str, EmailResult]) -> float:
    36	    return max((results[e].signal_score for e in linked_emails(s) if e in results), default=0.0)
    37	
    38	
    39	def _pool(group: list[Suggestion]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    40	    """Every claim and every distinct section of the group, in first-seen order."""
    41	    sections: dict[tuple[str, str], LinkedSection] = {}
    42	    for s in group:
    43	        for sec in s.sections:
    44	            sections.setdefault((sec.email_id, sec.quote), sec)
    45	    return {
    46	        "claim_ids": list(dict.fromkeys(c for s in group for c in s.claim_ids)),
    47	        "sections": list(sections.values()),
    48	    }
    49	
    50	
    51	def merge_existing(group: list[Suggestion], results: dict[str, EmailResult]) -> Suggestion:
    52	    """One suggestion for one pillar and stance."""
    53	    bodies = [s.body for s in group if isinstance(s.body, ExistingThesis)]
    54	    strongest = max(range(len(group)),
    55	                    key=lambda i: (bodies[i].strength, _signal(group[i], results), -i))
    56	    pooled: dict[tuple[str, float], LinkedAssumption] = {}
    57	    for b in bodies:
    58	        for a in b.assumptions:
    59	            pooled.setdefault((a.driver_id, a.stated_value), a)
    60	    body = bodies[strongest].model_copy(update={
    61	        "wrong_if_met": any(b.wrong_if_met for b in bodies),
    62	        "assumptions": list(pooled.values()),
    63	    })
    64	    lead = bodies[strongest]
    65	    return group[strongest].model_copy(update={
    66	        "id": f"{lead.pillar_id}.{lead.stance}", "body": body, **_pool(group),
    67	    })
    68	
    69	
    70	def merge_new(group: list[Suggestion], ticker: str, n: int) -> Suggestion:
    71	    """One candidate from similar new-thesis candidates for one company; the first is kept."""
    72	    bodies = [s.body for s in group if isinstance(s.body, NewThesis)]
    73	    drivers = list(dict.fromkeys(d for b in bodies for d in b.driver_ids))
    74	    return group[0].model_copy(update={
    75	        "id": f"{ticker}.new{n}", "body": bodies[0].model_copy(update={"driver_ids": drivers}),
    76	        **_pool(group),
    77	    })
    78	
    79	
    80	def group_new(candidates: list[Suggestion], ctx: RunContext) -> list[list[Suggestion]]:
    81	    """Greedy grouping in arrival order against each group's first statement."""
    82	    if not candidates:
    83	        return []
    84	    vectors = ctx.embedder.embed([s.body.statement for s in candidates if isinstance(s.body, NewThesis)])
    85	    groups: list[list[int]] = []
    86	    for i in range(len(candidates)):
    87	        for g in groups:
    88	            if float(vectors[g[0]] @ vectors[i]) >= thresholds.NEW_THESIS_MERGE:
    89	                g.append(i)
    90	                break
    91	        else:
    92	            groups.append([i])
    93	    return [[candidates[i] for i in g] for g in groups]
    94	
    95	
    96	def process(suggestions: list[Suggestion], ctx: RunContext, results: list[EmailResult],
    97	            seed: Seed) -> list[Suggestion]:
    98	    """One suggestion per pillar and stance, merged and ordered."""
    99	    by_email = {r.email_id: r for r in results}
   100	    size: dict[str, int] = {t.ticker: t.size_bps for t in seed.theses}
   101	    existing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[Suggestion]] = defaultdict(list)
   102	    new: dict[str, list[Suggestion]] = defaultdict(list)
   103	    for s in suggestions:
   104	        if s.status != "open":
   105	            continue
   106	        if isinstance(s.body, ExistingThesis):
   107	            existing[(s.body.pillar_id, s.body.stance)].append(s)
   108	        elif isinstance(s.body, NewThesis):
   109	            new[s.body.ticker].append(s)
   110	
   111	    merged_existing = [merge_existing(g, by_email) for g in existing.values()]
   112	    merged_new = [merge_new(g, ticker, n)
   113	                  for ticker, candidates in new.items()
   114	                  for n, g in enumerate(group_new(candidates, ctx), start=1)]
   115	    merged = [m.model_copy(update={"second_look": needs_second_look(m, by_email)})
   116	              for m in merged_existing + merged_new]
   117	
   118	    def ticker_of(s: Suggestion) -> str:
   119	        b = s.body
   120	        return b.pillar_id.split(".")[0] if isinstance(b, ExistingThesis) else b.ticker
   121	
   122	    def strength(s: Suggestion) -> int:
   123	        return s.body.strength if isinstance(s.body, ExistingThesis) else 0
   124	
   125	    return sorted(merged, key=lambda s: (
   126	        isinstance(s.body, NewThesis), -size.get(ticker_of(s), 0), -strength(s),
   127	        -_signal(s, by_email), s.id,
   128	    ))
   129	
   130	
   131	def run(in_dir: Path, out_dir: Path, ctx: RunContext, seed: Seed | None = None) -> None:
   132	    # Merging works across emails, so it is timed once for the set (by run.py), not per email.
   133	    checked = read_list(in_dir / "suggestions_checked.json", Suggestion)
   134	    results = read_list(in_dir / "results.json", EmailResult)
   135	    write_list(out_dir / "suggestions.json", process(checked, ctx, results, seed or load_seed()))

   141	def brief_alerts(suggestions: list[Suggestion], res: dict[str, EmailResult], triage: dict[str, TriageRecord],
   142	                 sizes: dict[str, int]) -> list[Alert]:
   143	    """Met "wrong if" tests by position size, then attention items by probability; budget first-come."""
   144	    met = [s for s in suggestions if isinstance(s.body, ExistingThesis) and s.body.wrong_if_met

   146	    met.sort(key=lambda s: -sizes.get(suggestion_ticker(s), 0))

332	   332	            return templates.TemplateResponse(
333	   333	                request, "live.html", {"v": v, "now": datetime.now(UTC), "presets": list(presets.values()), **ctx},
334	   334	                status_code=code)
335	   335	
336	   336	        if preset:
337	   337	            if preset not in presets:
338	   338	                return answer(None, f"unknown preset {preset}", 404)
339	   339	            email = presets[preset]

343	   343	            total = len(sender) + len(sender_email) + len(subject) + len(body)

346	   346	                                    f"{thresholds.LIVE_INPUT_CAP_CHARS:,}", 413)
347	   347	            # Presets replay cached results; only a pasted email spends from the hourly allowance.

349	   349	                return answer(None, f"this session has used its {thresholds.LIVE_RUNS_PER_HOUR} live runs "

368	   368	        tokens: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
369	   369	        for c in v.data.calls:
370	   370	            if c.email_id is None:
371	   371	                continue
372	   372	            tokens[c.email_id][0] += c.input_tokens + c.output_tokens
373	   373	            if not c.cache_hit:
374	   374	                tokens[c.email_id][1] += c.input_tokens + c.output_tokens
375	   375	        latency: dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
376	   376	        for t in v.data.timings:
377	   377	            if t.email_id is not None:
378	   378	                latency[t.email_id] += t.latency_ms
379	   379	        costliest = sorted(tokens.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][0])[:MONITOR_TOP_EMAILS]
380	   380	        slowest = sorted(latency.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:MONITOR_TOP_EMAILS]

385	   385	    def accept_and_report(request: Request, v: View, s: Suggestion, **edits: Any) -> Response:

387	   387	            entry = apply.accept(seed, v.sess.log, s, **edits)

   272	        except NotImplementedError as e:
   273	            raise NotAvailable("the verify agent is not built yet") from e
   274	    return result

1	"""Read-only view of one set's stage files for the app.
     2	
     3	The directory comes from `TRIAGE_DATA_DIR` (default `data/out/day_1`). Files are read once
     4	and reloaded when any of them changes on disk. A missing file reads as empty, so the app
     5	answers before every stage has run. Nothing here writes.
     6	"""
     7	
     8	import json
     9	import os
    10	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    11	from pathlib import Path
    12	
    13	from markupsafe import Markup, escape
    14	from pydantic import BaseModel
    15	
    16	from triage_app import config
    17	from triage_app.pipeline.io import normalize_ws, read_list, read_one
    18	from triage_app.schema import (
    19	    AnalysisRecord, AttentionNote, Brief, CallRecord, Claim, CriteriaHistoryEntry, Email, EmailResult,
    20	    EvalReport, LinkedSection, RedundancyRecord, StageTiming, Suggestion, TriageRecord, UsageReport,
    21	)
    22	
    23	DEFAULT_DATA_DIR = config.OUT_DIR / "day_1"
    24	
    25	
    26	def data_dir_from_env() -> Path:
    27	    raw = os.environ.get("TRIAGE_DATA_DIR", "").strip()
    28	    if not raw:
    29	        return DEFAULT_DATA_DIR
    30	    path = Path(raw)
    31	    return path if path.is_absolute() else config.ROOT / path
    32	
    33	
    34	@dataclass
    35	class DayData:
    36	    """Every stage file of one set, with lookups by ID."""
    37	
    38	    directory: Path
    39	    raw: list[Email] = field(default_factory=list)
    40	    parsed: list[Email] = field(default_factory=list)
    41	    redundancy: dict[str, RedundancyRecord] = field(default_factory=dict)
    42	    triage: dict[str, TriageRecord] = field(default_factory=dict)
    43	    results: dict[str, EmailResult] = field(default_factory=dict)
    44	    notes: dict[str, AttentionNote] = field(default_factory=dict)
    45	    claims: list[Claim] = field(default_factory=list)
    46	    analysis: dict[str, AnalysisRecord] = field(default_factory=dict)
    47	    checked: list[Suggestion] = field(default_factory=list)
    48	    suggestions: dict[str, Suggestion] = field(default_factory=dict)
    49	    brief: Brief | None = None
    50	    eval: EvalReport | None = None
    51	    metrics: UsageReport | None = None
    52	    calls: list[CallRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    53	    timings: list[StageTiming] = field(default_factory=list)
    54	    history: list[CriteriaHistoryEntry] = field(default_factory=list)
    55	
    56	    @property
    57	    def emails(self) -> dict[str, Email]:
    58	        return {e.email_id: e for e in self.parsed}
    59	
    60	    @property
    61	    def raw_by_id(self) -> dict[str, Email]:
    62	        return {e.email_id: e for e in self.raw}
    63	
    64	    def quarantined(self, email_id: str) -> bool:
    65	        r = self.results.get(email_id)
    66	        return r is not None and r.gate == "quarantine"
    67	
    68	    def rejected(self) -> list[Suggestion]:
    69	        return [s for s in self.checked if s.status == "rejected"]
    70	
    71	    def no_change_reason(self, email_id: str) -> str | None:
    72	        """The analysis record's reason, or the code-written one when every suggestion was rejected."""
    73	        a = self.analysis.get(email_id)
    74	        if a is None:
    75	            return None
    76	        if a.no_change_reason:
    77	            return a.no_change_reason
    78	        mine = [s for s in self.checked if s.id in a.suggestion_ids]
    79	        if mine and all(s.status == "rejected" for s in mine):
    80	            return "all suggestions rejected in validation"
    81	        return None
    82	
    83	    def quotes_for(self, email_id: str) -> list[str]:
    84	        """Every quoted section of one email shown anywhere: notes, claims and valid suggestions."""
    85	        out: list[str] = []
    86	        note = self.notes.get(email_id)
    87	        if note:
    88	            out += [s.quote for s in note.sections]
    89	        out += [c.quote for c in self.claims if c.email_id == email_id]
    90	        for s in self.suggestions.values():
    91	            out += [x.quote for x in s.sections if x.email_id == email_id]
    92	        return out
    93	
    94	
    95	def _list[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> list[M]:
    96	    return read_list(path, model) if path.exists() else []
    97	
    98	
    99	def _one[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> M | None:
   100	    return read_one(path, model) if path.exists() else None
   101	
   102	
   103	def load(directory: Path) -> DayData:
   104	    d = directory
   105	    usage = json.loads((d / "usage.json").read_text()) if (d / "usage.json").exists() else {}
   106	    history_path = d / "criteria_history.json"
   107	    if not history_path.exists():
   108	        history_path = d.parent / "criteria_history.json"
   109	    return DayData(
   110	        directory=d,
   111	        raw=_list(d / "raw.json", Email),
   112	        parsed=_list(d / "parsed.json", Email),
   113	        redundancy={r.email_id: r for r in _list(d / "redundancy.json", RedundancyRecord)},
   114	        triage={t.email_id: t for t in _list(d / "triage.json", TriageRecord)},
   115	        results={r.email_id: r for r in _list(d / "results.json", EmailResult)},
   116	        notes={n.email_id: n for n in _list(d / "notes.json", AttentionNote)},
   117	        claims=_list(d / "claims.json", Claim),
   118	        analysis={a.email_id: a for a in _list(d / "analysis.json", AnalysisRecord)},
   119	        checked=_list(d / "suggestions_checked.json", Suggestion),
   120	        suggestions={s.id: s for s in _list(d / "suggestions.json", Suggestion)},
   121	        brief=_one(d / "brief.json", Brief),
   122	        eval=_one(d / "eval.json", EvalReport),
   123	        metrics=_one(d / "metrics.json", UsageReport),
   124	        calls=[CallRecord.model_validate(c) for c in usage.get("calls", [])],
   125	        timings=[StageTiming.model_validate(t) for t in usage.get("timings", [])],
   126	        history=_list(history_path, CriteriaHistoryEntry),
   127	    )
   128	
   129	
   130	class DataStore:
   131	    """Holds the loaded set and reloads it when a stage file changes."""
   132	
   133	    def __init__(self, directory: Path) -> None:
   134	        self.directory = directory
   135	        self._stamp: tuple[float, ...] | None = None
   136	        self._data: DayData | None = None
   137	
   138	    def _mtimes(self) -> tuple[float, ...]:
   139	        if not self.directory.exists():
   140	            return ()
   141	        return tuple(sorted(p.stat().st_mtime for p in self.directory.glob("*.json")))
   142	
   143	    def get(self) -> DayData:
   144	        stamp = self._mtimes()
   145	        if self._data is None or stamp != self._stamp:
   146	            self._data = load(self.directory)
   147	            self._stamp = stamp
   148	        return self._data
   149	
   150	
   151	# ---- Rendering helpers ----
   152	
   153	def highlight(body: str, quotes: list[str]) -> Markup:
   154	    """The parsed body as HTML, with each quoted section wrapped in <mark>.
   155	
   156	    Quotes are matched after whitespace normalization, as the pipeline checks them.
   157	    """
   158	    text = normalize_ws(body)
   159	    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
   160	    for q in {normalize_ws(q) for q in quotes if q.strip()}:
   161	        start = text.find(q)
   162	        while start != -1:
   163	            spans.append((start, start + len(q)))
   164	            start = text.find(q, start + 1)
   165	    merged: list[list[int]] = []
   166	    for a, b in sorted(spans):
   167	        if merged and a <= merged[-1][1]:
   168	            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], b)
   169	        else:
   170	            merged.append([a, b])
   171	    parts: list[str] = []
   172	    pos = 0
   173	    for n, (a, b) in enumerate(merged, 1):
   174	        parts.append(str(escape(text[pos:a])))
   175	        parts.append(f'<mark id="q{n}">{escape(text[a:b])}</mark>')
   176	        pos = b
   177	    parts.append(str(escape(text[pos:])))
   178	    return Markup("".join(parts))
   179	
   180	
   181	def safe_sections(sections: list[LinkedSection], data: DayData) -> list[LinkedSection]:
   182	    """Drop any section from a quarantined email: its body reaches no screen."""
   183	    return [s for s in sections if not data.quarantined(s.email_id)]
     1	"""Per-visitor session state, held in server memory and keyed by a signed session cookie.
     2	
     3	Holds the change log, dismissed suggestions and reviews, live-run times, verify results,
     4	and whatever live runs and "this mattered" added to the visitor's brief. A restart clears
     5	every session. Reset clears the visitor's state but keeps the live-run times, so it cannot
     6	be used to lift the rate limit.
     7	"""
     8	
     9	import secrets
    10	import threading
    11	import time
    12	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    13	
    14	from triage_app import thresholds
    15	from triage_app.schema import AttentionNote, Claim, Email, EmailResult, LogEntry, Suggestion, VerifyResult
    16	
    17	SESSION_KEY = "sid"
    18	
    19	
    20	@dataclass
    21	class SessionState:
    22	    log: list[LogEntry] = field(default_factory=list)
    23	    dismissed: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    24	    live_runs: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    25	    verify: dict[str, VerifyResult] = field(default_factory=dict)
    26	    # Added to this session's brief by the live route and "this mattered".
    27	    emails: dict[str, Email] = field(default_factory=dict)
    28	    results: dict[str, EmailResult] = field(default_factory=dict)
    29	    notes: dict[str, AttentionNote] = field(default_factory=dict)
    30	    suggestions: dict[str, Suggestion] = field(default_factory=dict)
    31	    claims: list[Claim] = field(default_factory=list)
    32	    mattered: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # email ID to outcome line
    33	
    34	    def reset(self) -> None:
    35	        self.__dict__.update(SessionState(live_runs=self.live_runs).__dict__)
    36	
    37	    def runs_left(self, now: float | None = None) -> int:
    38	        now = time.time() if now is None else now
    39	        self.live_runs = [t for t in self.live_runs if now - t < thresholds.LIVE_RATE_WINDOW_S]
    40	        return max(0, thresholds.LIVE_RUNS_PER_HOUR - len(self.live_runs))
    41	
    42	    def take_run(self, now: float | None = None) -> bool:
    43	        """Spend one live run from the hourly allowance; False when none is left."""
    44	        now = time.time() if now is None else now
    45	        if self.runs_left(now) <= 0:
    46	            return False
    47	        self.live_runs.append(now)
    48	        return True
    49	
    50	
    51	class SessionStore:
    52	    def __init__(self) -> None:
    53	        self._sessions: dict[str, SessionState] = {}
    54	        self._lock = threading.Lock()
    55	
    56	    @staticmethod
    57	    def new_id() -> str:
    58	        return secrets.token_urlsafe(18)
    59	
    60	    def get(self, sid: str) -> SessionState:
    61	        with self._lock:
    62	            return self._sessions.setdefault(sid, SessionState())

1	"""Analyst actions to change-log entries. Pure functions over (seed, log).
     2	
     3	See SPEC.md, "What the analyst can do" and "The change log". Each function reads the
     4	current state as fold(seed, log) and returns the new LogEntry to append; it never mutates
     5	the seed or the log, and never writes a file. Code fills every before/after value and
     6	assigns every ID.
     7	
     8	- Accept on an existing thesis logs `pillar_evidence` against the pillar.
     9	- Accept on a new thesis logs `pillar_added` with the next free pillar ID.
    10	- Update a linked assumption logs `driver_updated` with the current value as `before`.
    11	- Set conviction logs `conviction_changed`; the value is the analyst's, never proposed.
    12	- Undo appends a reversing entry for the last change still in effect.
    13	- Dismiss changes only the suggestion's status in the session; it writes no entry.
    14	
    15	A conviction review is raised by code when accepted contradicting evidence on one pillar
    16	reaches `thresholds.CONVICTION_REVIEW_STRENGTH`. It is open until the analyst sets conviction
    17	against it (a log entry whose `suggestion_id` is the review's ID) or dismisses it.
    18	"""
    19	
    20	from collections.abc import Iterable
    21	from datetime import UTC, datetime
    22	from typing import Literal
    23	
    24	from triage_app import thresholds
    25	from triage_app.schema import (
    26	    ConvictionReview, ExistingThesis, LinkedSection, LogEntry, NewThesis, Pillar, Suggestion, Ticker,
    27	)
    28	from triage_app.state.fold import BookState, Seed, effective_entries, fold, net_contradicting, next_pillar_id
    29	
    30	Strength = Literal[1, 2, 3]
    31	Status = Literal["open", "accepted", "dismissed", "rejected"]
    32	
    33	REVIEW_SUFFIX = ".review"
    34	
    35	
    36	class ActionError(ValueError):
    37	    """An action the current state does not allow; the message is shown to the analyst."""
    38	
    39	
    40	def _now(at: datetime | None) -> datetime:
    41	    return at or datetime.now(UTC)
    42	
    43	
    44	def next_entry_id(log: list[LogEntry]) -> str:
    45	    return f"log{len(log) + 1}"
    46	
    47	
    48	def accepted_ids(log: list[LogEntry]) -> set[str]:
    49	    """Suggestion IDs with an accept still in effect."""
    50	    return {e.suggestion_id for e in effective_entries(log)
    51	            if e.change in ("pillar_evidence", "pillar_added")}
    52	
    53	
    54	def status_of(suggestion: Suggestion, log: list[LogEntry], dismissed: Iterable[str]) -> Status:
    55	    """A suggestion's status in the session: accepted from the log, dismissed from the session."""
    56	    if suggestion.status == "rejected":
    57	        return "rejected"
    58	    if suggestion.id in accepted_ids(log):
    59	        return "accepted"
    60	    if suggestion.id in set(dismissed):
    61	        return "dismissed"
    62	    return "open"
    63	
    64	
    65	# ---- Accept ----
    66	
    67	def accept(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], suggestion: Suggestion, *, strength: Strength | None = None,
    68	           statement: str | None = None, wrong_if: str | None = None, at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry:
    69	    """Accept one suggestion, optionally edited: a new strength, or new wording for a new pillar."""
    70	    if suggestion.status == "rejected":
    71	        raise ActionError(f"{suggestion.id} was rejected in validation and cannot be accepted")
    72	    if suggestion.id in accepted_ids(log):
    73	        raise ActionError(f"{suggestion.id} is already accepted")
    74	    body = suggestion.body
    75	    if isinstance(body, ExistingThesis):
    76	        return accept_existing(seed, log, suggestion, body, strength=strength, at=at)
    77	    if isinstance(body, NewThesis):
    78	        return accept_new(seed, log, suggestion, body, statement=statement, wrong_if=wrong_if, at=at)
    79	    raise ActionError("a conviction review is answered by setting conviction, not by accepting it")
    80	
    81	
    82	def accept_existing(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], suggestion: Suggestion, body: ExistingThesis, *,
    83	                    strength: Strength | None = None, at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry:
    84	    state = fold(seed, log)
    85	    if body.pillar_id not in state.evidence:
    86	        raise ActionError(f"unknown pillar {body.pillar_id}")
    87	    return LogEntry(
    88	        id=next_entry_id(log), at=_now(at), suggestion_id=suggestion.id, change="pillar_evidence",
    89	        item_id=body.pillar_id, stance=body.stance, strength=strength or body.strength,
    90	        sections=list(suggestion.sections),
    91	    )
    92	
    93	
    94	def accept_new(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], suggestion: Suggestion, body: NewThesis, *,
    95	               statement: str | None = None, wrong_if: str | None = None, at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry:
    96	    state = fold(seed, log)
    97	    pillar_id = next_pillar_id(state, body.ticker)
    98	    statement = (statement or "").strip() or body.statement
    99	    wrong_if = (wrong_if or "").strip() or body.wrong_if
   100	    pillar = Pillar(id=pillar_id, statement=statement, wrong_if=wrong_if, driver_ids=list(body.driver_ids))
   101	    return LogEntry(
   102	        id=next_entry_id(log), at=_now(at), suggestion_id=suggestion.id, change="pillar_added",
   103	        item_id=pillar_id, pillar=pillar, sections=list(suggestion.sections),
   104	    )
   105	
   106	
   107	# ---- Assumptions and conviction ----
   108	
   109	def update_driver(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], driver_id: str, value: float, *, suggestion_id: str = "",
   110	                  sections: list[LinkedSection] | None = None, at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry:
   111	    """Change one driver's analyst value. `before` is the current value, filled by code."""
   112	    state = fold(seed, log)
   113	    ticker = driver_id.split(".")[0]
   114	    model = next((m for t, m in state.models.items() if t == ticker), None)
   115	    driver = next((d for d in model.drivers if d.id == driver_id), None) if model else None
   116	    if driver is None:
   117	        raise ActionError(f"unknown driver {driver_id}")
   118	    if not driver.min <= value <= driver.max:
   119	        raise ActionError(f"{driver_id}: {value:g} is outside its bounds ({driver.min:g} to {driver.max:g})")
   120	    if value == driver.analyst:
   121	        raise ActionError(f"{driver_id} is already {value:g}")
   122	    return LogEntry(
   123	        id=next_entry_id(log), at=_now(at), suggestion_id=suggestion_id, change="driver_updated",
   124	        item_id=driver_id, before=driver.analyst, after=value, sections=list(sections or []),
   125	    )
   126	
   127	
   128	def set_conviction(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], ticker: Ticker, conviction: int, *,
   129	                   suggestion_id: str = "", at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry:
   130	    """Set a company's conviction to the analyst's chosen value, 1 to 5."""
   131	    if conviction not in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
   132	        raise ActionError("conviction must be a whole number from 1 to 5")
   133	    state = fold(seed, log)
   134	    if ticker not in state.theses:
   135	        raise ActionError(f"unknown ticker {ticker}")
   136	    sections = [s for e in state.evidence.get(_review_pillar(suggestion_id), []) for s in e.sections]
   137	    return LogEntry(
   138	        id=next_entry_id(log), at=_now(at), suggestion_id=suggestion_id, change="conviction_changed",
   139	        item_id=ticker, before=float(state.theses[ticker].conviction), after=float(conviction),
   140	        sections=sections,
   141	    )
   142	
   143	
   144	# ---- Undo ----
   145	
   146	def undo(log: list[LogEntry], *, at: datetime | None = None) -> LogEntry | None:
   147	    """A reversing entry for the last change still in effect, or None when there is none."""
   148	    live = effective_entries(log)
   149	    if not live:
   150	        return None
   151	    last = live[-1]
   152	    return LogEntry(
   153	        id=next_entry_id(log), at=_now(at), suggestion_id=last.suggestion_id, change=last.change,
   154	        item_id=last.item_id, before=last.after, after=last.before, stance=last.stance,
   155	        strength=last.strength, pillar=last.pillar, reverses=last.id, sections=list(last.sections),
   156	    )
   157	
   158	
   159	# ---- Conviction reviews ----
   160	
   161	def review_id(pillar_id: str) -> str:
   162	    return f"{pillar_id}{REVIEW_SUFFIX}"
   163	
   164	
   165	def _review_pillar(suggestion_id: str) -> str:
   166	    return suggestion_id.removesuffix(REVIEW_SUFFIX) if suggestion_id.endswith(REVIEW_SUFFIX) else ""
   167	
   168	
   169	def conviction_reviews(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry], dismissed: Iterable[str] = ()) -> list[Suggestion]:
   170	    """Open conviction reviews: pillars whose net contradicting strength reaches the threshold,
   171	    not yet answered by a conviction change on the review and not dismissed."""
   172	    state = fold(seed, log)
   173	    answered = {e.suggestion_id for e in state.applied if e.change == "conviction_changed"}
   174	    gone = set(dismissed) | answered
   175	    out: list[Suggestion] = []
   176	    for ticker, thesis in state.theses.items():
   177	        for pillar in thesis.pillars:
   178	            net = net_contradicting(state, pillar.id)
   179	            rid = review_id(pillar.id)
   180	            if net < thresholds.CONVICTION_REVIEW_STRENGTH or rid in gone:
   181	                continue
   182	            out.append(review_suggestion(state, ticker, pillar.id, net))
   183	    return out

   189	        id=review_id(pillar_id),

   191	        rationale=(f"Accepted contradicting evidence on {pillar_id} reaches a net strength of {net}, "
   192	                   f"at or above the review threshold of {thresholds.CONVICTION_REVIEW_STRENGTH}."),
   193	        claim_ids=[],
   194	        sections=[s for e in entries if e.stance == "contradicts" for s in e.sections],

"""Current book state = seed + change log. Never stored; always recomputed.

See SPEC.md, "State: model, thesis and change log". An undo appends an entry whose
`reverses` names the entry it cancels; an undo of an undo restores the original.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic import BaseModel

from triage_app.config import SEED_DIR
from triage_app.schema import CompanyModel, Link, LogEntry, Thesis, Ticker


class Seed(BaseModel):
    theses: list[Thesis]
    models: list[CompanyModel]
    links: list[Link]


class BookState(BaseModel):
    theses: dict[Ticker, Thesis]
    models: dict[Ticker, CompanyModel]
    links: list[Link]
    evidence: dict[str, list[LogEntry]]   # pillar ID to accepted pillar_evidence entries
    applied: list[LogEntry]               # log entries in effect, in log order


def load_seed(seed_dir: Path = SEED_DIR) -> Seed:
    def read(name: str) -> object:
        return json.loads((seed_dir / name).read_text())

    return Seed.model_validate({
        "theses": read("theses.json"),
        "models": read("models.json"),
        "links": read("links.json"),
    })


def effective_entries(log: list[LogEntry]) -> list[LogEntry]:
    """Entries still in effect: not cancelled by a later undo, and not undos themselves."""
    cancelled: set[str] = set()
    for entry in reversed(log):
        if entry.id in cancelled:
            continue
        if entry.reverses is not None:
            cancelled.add(entry.reverses)
    return [e for e in log if e.id not in cancelled and e.reverses is None]


def fold(seed: Seed, log: list[LogEntry]) -> BookState:
    theses = {t.ticker: t.model_copy(deep=True) for t in seed.theses}
    models = {m.ticker: m.model_copy(deep=True) for m in seed.models}
    evidence: dict[str, list[LogEntry]] = {p.id: [] for t in theses.values() for p in t.pillars}
    applied = effective_entries(log)

    for entry in applied:
        match entry.change:
            case "pillar_evidence":
                evidence.setdefault(entry.item_id, []).append(entry)
            case "pillar_added":
                if entry.pillar is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{entry.id}: pillar_added without a pillar")
                ticker = entry.item_id.split(".")[0]
                theses[ticker].pillars.append(entry.pillar)  # type: ignore[index]
                evidence.setdefault(entry.pillar.id, [])
            case "driver_updated":
                if entry.after is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{entry.id}: driver_updated without a value")
                ticker = entry.item_id.split(".")[0]
                model = models[ticker]  # type: ignore[index]
                for d in model.drivers:
                    if d.id == entry.item_id:
                        d.analyst = entry.after
                        break
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"{entry.id}: unknown driver {entry.item_id}")
            case "conviction_changed":
                if entry.after is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{entry.id}: conviction_changed without a value")
                thesis = theses[entry.item_id]  # type: ignore[index]
                thesis.conviction = int(entry.after)  # type: ignore[assignment]

    return BookState(theses=theses, models=models, links=seed.links, evidence=evidence, applied=applied)


def net_contradicting(state: BookState, pillar_id: str) -> int:
    """Summed strength of accepted contradicting evidence minus supporting evidence."""
    total = 0
    for e in state.evidence.get(pillar_id, []):
        strength = e.strength or 0
        total += strength if e.stance == "contradicts" else -strength
    return total


def next_pillar_id(state: BookState, ticker: Ticker) -> str:
    """The next free pillar ID for a company, such as AAPL.p4."""
    numbers = [int(p.id.split(".p")[1]) for p in state.theses[ticker].pillars]
    return f"{ticker}.p{max(numbers, default=0) + 1}"

    13	- quarantine threshold: not tuned (config.py).

    36	def is_quarantined(t: TriageRecord, threshold: float = limits.QUARANTINE) -> bool:
    37	    """Either safety probability reaches the quarantine threshold (DECISIONS #19)."""
    38	    return max(t.safety.values(), default=0.0) >= threshold
    39	
    40	
    41	def _floor4(x: float) -> float:
    42	    scale = float(10 ** limits.PASS_THRESHOLD_DECIMALS)
    43	    return math.floor(x * scale + 1e-9) / scale
    44	
    45	
    46	# ---- Sweeps ----
    47	
    48	def fit_pass_threshold(relevant: Sequence[float], monitor: Sequence[float], default: float,
    49	                       monitor_share: float = limits.MONITOR_PASS_SHARE) -> float:
    50	    """Highest threshold t with every relevant score >= t and at least `monitor_share` of monitor scores >= t."""
    51	    bounds = []
    52	    if relevant:
    53	        bounds.append(min(relevant))
    54	    if monitor:
    55	        need = math.ceil(monitor_share * len(monitor) - 1e-9)
    56	        bounds.append(sorted(monitor, reverse=True)[max(need, 1) - 1])
    57	    return _floor4(min(bounds)) if bounds else default
    58	
    59	
    60	def f1_at(probs: Sequence[float], truth: Sequence[bool], threshold: float) -> float | None:
    61	    tp = sum(1 for p, y in zip(probs, truth) if p >= threshold and y)
    62	    fp = sum(1 for p, y in zip(probs, truth) if p >= threshold and not y)
    63	    fn = sum(1 for p, y in zip(probs, truth) if p < threshold and y)
    64	    return 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn) if tp + fp + fn else None
    65	
    66	
    67	def fit_f1_threshold(probs: Sequence[float], truth: Sequence[bool], default: float) -> float:
    68	    """Threshold with the best F1. Candidates sit midway between neighbouring probabilities,
    69	    plus the lowest one; ties go to the candidate nearest the starting value. With no
    70	    positive example the starting value stays."""
    71	    if not any(truth):
    72	        return default
    73	    values = sorted(set(probs))
    74	    candidates = [values[0], *((a + b) / 2 for a, b in zip(values, values[1:]))]
    75	    best = max(candidates, key=lambda t: (f1_at(probs, truth, t) or 0.0, -abs(t - default)))
    76	    return round(best, 4)
    77	
    78	
    79	# ---- Fitting ----
    80	
    81	def fit_thresholds(triage: Iterable[TriageRecord], labels: Mapping[str, EmailLabel],
    82	                   fit_ids: set[str], start: Thresholds | None = None) -> Thresholds:
    83	    """Every tuned threshold, fit on the emails in `fit_ids`; redundancy values from config."""

    91	        [signal_score(t) for t, lab in gated if lab.triage == "monitor"],
    92	        start.pass_signal)
    93	    attention = fit_f1_threshold([t.attention for t, _ in live], [lab.human_attention for _, lab in live],
    94	                                 start.attention)
    95	    ticker = {k: fit_f1_threshold([t.ticker_probs.get(k, 0.0) for t, _ in live],
    96	                                  [k in lab.affected_tickers for _, lab in live], start.ticker.get(k, limits.TICKER_THRESHOLD))
    97	              for k in config.TICKERS}
    98	    topic = {k: fit_f1_threshold([t.topic_probs.get(k, 0.0) for t, _ in live],
    99	                                 [k in lab.additional_labels for _, lab in live], start.topic.get(k, limits.TOPIC_THRESHOLD))
   100	             for k in config.TOPICS}
   101	    return Thresholds(
   102	        pass_signal=pass_signal, attention=attention, ticker=ticker, topic=topic,
   103	        content_similarity=limits.CONTENT_SIMILARITY,
   104	        content_similarity_with_subject=limits.CONTENT_SIMILARITY_WITH_SUBJECT,
   105	        subject_match=limits.SUBJECT_MATCH,
   106	    )

   110	
   111	def split_ids(emails: list[Email], labels: list[EmailLabel]) -> dict[str, Split]:
   112	    """Fit or validation for each tuning email, from the loader's stratified split."""
   113	    from triage_app import corpus
   114	    split = corpus.split_tuning(emails, labels)

   116	    out.update({e.email_id: "validation" for e in split.val_emails})
   117	    return out
   118	
   119

   121	    out_dir = out_dir or config.out_dir("tuning")
   122	    return config.corpus_file("tuning").exists() and all((out_dir / n).exists() for n in needed)
   123	
   124	
   125	def describe(th: Thresholds, triage: list[TriageRecord], labels: Mapping[str, EmailLabel],
   126	             split: Mapping[str, Split]) -> str:
   127	    """Each fitted threshold with its F1 on the fit and validation splits."""
   128	    lines = [f"  pass_signal  {th.pass_signal:.4f}"]
   129	
   130	    def row(name: str, value: float, prob: Any, truth: Any) -> str:

   140	    for k, v in th.ticker.items():

   143	        lines.append(row(k, v, lambda t, k=k: t.topic_probs.get(k, 0.0), lambda lab, k=k: k in lab.additional_labels))

   158	    print(describe(thresholds, triage, by_id, split))

     2	
     3	    uv run python -m triage_app.evals.criteria_check
     4	
     5	Reruns stage 3 (classify, through ctx.jev and the disk cache) and stage 4 (gate) on every
     6	tuning email, refits the thresholds in memory on the fit split (never written to
     7	tuned/thresholds.json), and prints the label measures before and after on the fit and
     8	validation splits, with every email whose label changed. "Before" is the previous
     9	criteria version's entry in data/out/criteria_history.json. The check then appends this
    10	version's entry there (one entry per version: rerunning a version replaces its entry).
    11	
    12	Each version's labels are kept beside the tuning output, in
    13	data/out/tuning/criteria_check/<version>.json (EmailResult list), so the next version can
    14	list the emails it relabeled. Nothing else is written. See SPEC.md, "Relevance criteria"
    15	and the keep rule under "Tuning".
    16	"""
    17	
    18	import argparse
    19	from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
    20	from datetime import UTC, datetime
    21	from pathlib import Path
    22	
    23	from pydantic import TypeAdapter
    24	
    25	from triage_app import config
    26	from triage_app import criteria as criteria_files
    27	from triage_app.evals import metric, tune
    28	from triage_app.evals.score import load_corpus
    29	from triage_app.evals.tune import Split
    30	from triage_app.pipeline import classify, gate
    31	from triage_app.pipeline.context import RunContext
    32	from triage_app.pipeline.io import read_list, write_list
    33	from triage_app.schema import (
    34	    CriteriaHistoryEntry,
    35	    Email,
    36	    EmailLabel,
    37	    EmailResult,
    38	    LabelChange,
    39	    RedundancyRecord,
    40	    Thresholds,
    41	    TriageRecord,
    42	)
    43	
    44	PENDING = "criteria check pending: tuning set not available"
    45	HISTORY = config.OUT_DIR / "criteria_history.json"
    46	NEEDED = ("parsed.json", "redundancy.json")
    47	
    48	Classify = Callable[[Email, RunContext], TriageRecord]
    49	Gate = Callable[[TriageRecord, RedundancyRecord, Thresholds], EmailResult]
    50	_HISTORY = TypeAdapter(list[CriteriaHistoryEntry])
    51	
    52	
    53	def read_history(path: Path = HISTORY) -> list[CriteriaHistoryEntry]:
    54	    return _HISTORY.validate_json(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else []
    55	
    56	
    57	def write_history(path: Path, entries: list[CriteriaHistoryEntry]) -> None:

    63	
    64	
    65	def split_measures(results: Mapping[str, EmailResult], labels: Mapping[str, EmailLabel],

    68	
    69	
    70	def label_changes(before: Mapping[str, EmailResult], after: Mapping[str, EmailResult],
    71	                  emails: Mapping[str, Email], labels: Mapping[str, EmailLabel],
    72	                  split: Mapping[str, Split]) -> list[LabelChange]:

    79	        changes.append(LabelChange(

    81	            split=split[email_id], now_correct=now.triage == labels[email_id].triage,

    86	def check(emails: list[Email], redundancy: Mapping[str, RedundancyRecord], labels: Mapping[str, EmailLabel],
